financing.headline: Roofing project financing
financing.description: Prefer to pay over time rather than all at once? Prequalify through Wisetack in a couple of minutes — it will not affect your credit score to check — then call us to talk through the work. All financing is subject to credit approval and your terms may vary. Payment options through Wisetack are provided by our lending partners. For example, a $1,200 purchase could cost $104.89 a month for 12 months based on an 8.9% APR, or $400 a month for 3 months based on a 0% APR. Offers range from 0–35.9% APR based on creditworthiness. There are no other financing charges or participation fees.
